kind: fresh scripted Deep Agents graphs using installed LangChain ToolRetryMiddleware and LangGraph synchronous step_timeout

native_retry_settings.retry_on: OSError only; simulated ResponseLost is a TimeoutError subclass
native_retry_settings.scope: per tool invocation; scripted model proposes once and never reissues a call

timeout_settings.expected_order: tool started, delayed release, receiver commit, timeout error observed by caller
timeout_settings.claim_boundary: Native synchronous timeout may wait during executor cleanup; no claim of a hard wall-clock return deadline or universal cancellation

invariants: Use create_deep_agent; no replacement agent loop or dependency patches
Stable operation ID across retries; one proposed tool call per case
Separate actual tool entries, committed receiver rows, receipts, model-facing tool status, graph completion and elapsed duration
Preserve unexpected failures and stop without automatic reruns
Keep protected replay receipts exact; unprotected broad retry is expected duplication, not task success
Trace error observations, release/commit order and controller cleanup; no lingering controlled tool thread
Validate saved observations separately from fresh unit/receiver checks
limitations: Scripted model and controlled local tool failures, not real provider/network latency
Zero-delay retry isolates attempt count and does not test backoff or jitter
Receiver reconciliation unavailable case reuses earlier validated evidence; no new service-outage graph case
